text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: <chrname> has finally earned the right to participate in the Twinkle Star Climax!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sharing in the joy with Reporter Otonashi, I come to learn about her extraordinary passion for the Twinkle Star Climax.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She wants people to see the moment a truly talented Umamusume proves her strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My desire to prove that <chrname> is the greatest grows even stronger.
